source.title: Frontier Sentinel, 6 May 1905, p. 5 ("The Elections: Newry No. 2 Rural District": withdrawals)
source.publisher: Frontier Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed after withdrawals, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 25 May 1905: "there were four elections" (Belfast News-Letter). The members returned unopposed in Ballybot, Belleek, Camlough, Mountnorris, Mullaghglass and Poyntzpass were not found in the reports read and are not filed. Returned unopposed. Bernard Cunningham withdrew, "with the result that Messrs. Edward Kinney and Terence Quinn, the retiring councillors, have been re-elected without opposition".
